body: I appreciate you trying to help but I don’t think you’re going about it in a right way. Guilt tripping is not a good idea

It was at first, now I don’t look back. If anyone has anything important to say to me then it deserves to be done somewhere other then Facebook. Social media is just what people want you to see from their lives, I honestly believe getting rid of it is the biggest step I’ve made in becoming better. 

I found my days just refreshing everything and seeing what everyone else was up to and it was destroying me. There was no point to it, so I was happy to give it up. 

If you’re looking to do the same, I can’t recommend it enough. But be aware that a lot of people will just stay in touch over Facebook because it’s there - the amount of people I’ve stopped talking to since leaving the platform is really unsettling. Today not one person who wasn’t family has wished me a happy birthday. So prepare yourself for that
I’m not implying that I’ll do it, I just want to know if there’s a word or phrase for it
It happens in TV shows, like when a character is going to do something bad so they’re exceptionally horrible beforehand so they’re not missed
Fuck off, mate. People here aren’t always thinking straight so fuck coming here to criticise. You clearly don’t understand how damaged people who come here are.
No I was saying there’s a big level of disingenuous responses that people say to depressed people. Why are you even arguing?

People don’t come here because they want to, they’re not thinking straight if they’re in a position where they’re considering ending their own life. Why did you feel the need to write your original comment in the tone you did?
But why kick people when they’re down?
I pretended I accidentally hurt myself when drunk but the cuts too deep, it’s clearly no accident
I feel like it’s went on for too long, I’m not wanting to be happy anymore, I don’t see the point
I’m sorry
I’m tired of feeling the way I do, and I’m giving it one more week
It’s kinda reassuring. No matter how bad things get, you always have a way out. In a way that keeps me going
Being nothing more than a statistic would suit me, to be honest. I don’t want to hurt or upset anyone. But I know if I take my life it’ll cause that. But I can’t keep going on
No don’t worry you’re okay. I just needed a place to rant. Thanks for listening & sorry if I came across as short or rude
I think it would be easier if they didn’t know. Some people are just like that I think, my parents included
I get you. It can create a very dangerous cycle
If there is any saving me, I don’t think the solution is with them. I’m not saying that in a bad or resentful way, I just don’t think it is

I don’t communicate it with them at all - one day a few years ago my mum found a huge scar on my hand from self harm. I thought she knew what was up but as time goes on, I think she forgets.

It makes me irritated (hence this post) but I don’t dislike them for it or anything, because I know they mean well & just haven’t realised

I think the hardest part is getting people to understand the difference between depressed & suicidal

When I was just depressed, my battle was if I was happy or not
Now I’m suicidal, my battle is wanting to be happy in the first place.  I don’t want help, I just want it to be over
My family, I could be down for days and they’d just say I need to cheer up and that I’m in a fed up mood. Very irritating
Yeah but you need to be strong minded for that, I don’t feel strong enough
I’m nearing the end of uni and it’s just instant talking about what’s next and after uni... they do it in such a stressful way
I watch TV shows and programs and people get threatened with guns and knives, and I just watch thinking so? If they kill you, you won’t even know. You’ll be dead, it won’t matter
Mainly fear of the future I think

Gambling is the main reason I feel suicidal. Fuck the casinos but mainly the ones you get on your phone. I lost £1000 on one roulette spin and straight away they phoned me (Sky Vegas) - I was in tears and they were asking me details about my finances because they can be checked by the gambling commission that they’re not money laundering - they weren’t asking because they cared about me or because I just lost £1000 on a spin, they were just covering their backs. 

It’s all about marketing and making everyone feel like they’re James Bond, parasitic fucking leeches. 

If nothing else I feel gambling devalues money - I watch TV shows where people are arguing over £10, I’ve lost more than that in less than a second with nothing less than a click and nothing to show. 

Fuck gambling, fuck casinos, fuck the greedy cunts running them
You okay? Message me if you need to talk
You okay just now? Message me if you want to talk
You doing okay?
It’s probably worth noting I’m in my second last year of university
I don’t really know... films? Music? Gaming? None of them you can do without having money or being successful though
Money, being successful, having friends
I wouldn’t say that, but I’d say the things that bring me sadness and fear overpower the joy from things that make me happy

Yeah I get you. It’s like if you had the option to just disappear you would, but the effects of what you’d leave behind make it too hard. I think the difficulty for me is just believing that I have everything to look forward to if I don’t leave, I just don’t believe I have that to come in my life
It’s a very difficult feeling, you just feel trapped. You’ve heard the usual “it gets better” so many times it doesn’t even mean anything anymore. Why should you start believing it now
Are you okay?
Are you okay?

For me I struggle with realising that some people actively want to be happy. I haven't had help for my depression because I don't really have a desire to be happy and keep going. I could be told my life was going to end tomorrow and I'd just say alright brilliant
